name: Jimi ni Shijimi 2
source:
You and your captain are on an adventure in search of the Shijimi Orb, which is said to grant any wish when using. At last, you find out where the Shijimi Orb is, but it turns out to be in a butler's café!
Find out who the mysterious butlers at the butler's cafe are, the trials that await you and the captain, and what your captain's wish is!

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/8126]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
你与队长踏上冒险，寻找据说能够实现任何愿望的蚬之宝珠。终于查明宝珠所在，却发现它竟然在一家执事咖啡馆里！
揭开咖啡馆里神秘执事们的身份，面对等待你与队长的考验，了解队长真正的愿望吧！

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/8126]NovelGame[/url]]
